workflows.title: Outline website content
workflows.body:
Create a page-by-page content outline from approved brief {{brief}}.
Audience: {{audience}}.
Page goal: {{page_goal}}.
Return page sections, the fact each section needs, and unanswered questions. Use supplied facts only; do not invent proof, pages or features.
workflows.notes: Draft candidate. Requires human review on three realistic briefs before approval.

workflow.example: Synthetic example: a solo service business with an approved brief; all names and claims are illustrative.
workflow.expectedOutput: A prioritized page/section outline with evidence needs and unanswered questions.
reviewChecklist: Trace every factual claim to the supplied brief.
Review all output before external use.
limits: Untested draft; model output may contain errors.
No browsing, execution or publishing is performed by this library.

workflows.body:
Draft a service page from approved offer facts:
{{offer_facts}}
Audience: {{audience}}.
Voice: {{voice}}.
Return headline options, short section drafts, a factual CTA and a list of missing evidence. Never invent pricing, testimonials, guarantees or results.

workflows.title: Review supplied website content
workflows.body:
Review only this supplied page content:
{{page_content}}
Page goal: {{page_goal}}.
Audience: {{audience}}.
Check clarity, hierarchy, task completion, factual support and CTA consistency. Quote the relevant supplied line for each issue. Do not claim to have visited URLs or tested interactions. Return prioritized findings and proposed revisions; keep uncertainty explicit.
workflows.notes: Draft candidate. Requires human review on three realistic briefs before approval.

workflow.example: Synthetic example: a solo service business with an approved brief; all names and claims are illustrative.
workflow.expectedOutput: Prioritized content findings tied to supplied lines, with proposed improvements.
reviewChecklist: Trace every factual claim to the supplied brief.
Review all output before external use.
limits: Untested draft; model output may contain errors.
No browsing, execution or publishing is performed by this library.

workflows.title: Prepare UAT and launch checks
workflows.body:
Create a UAT and launch checklist for this agreed delivery scope:
{{scope}}
Pages/routes: {{routes}}.
Known constraints: {{constraints}}.
Separate checks, expected results, responsible reviewer and evidence to collect. Mark anything requiring live access as not tested. Do not invent functionality, security results or deployment success.
workflows.notes: Draft candidate. Requires human review on three realistic briefs before approval.

workflow.expectedOutput: A scoped checklist with steps, expected results, owners and evidence fields.
